title.zh: 将布基农省 Don Carlos 市镇 Kiara 描笼涯的 Bocboc 国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Kiara 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Bocboc National High School - Kiara Annex in Barangay Kiara, Municipality of Don Carlos, Province of Bukidnon From the Bocboc National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to be Known as Kiara National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Separating the Bocboc National High School - Kiara Annex in Barangay Kiara, Municipality of Don Carlos, Province of Bukidnon From the Bocboc National High School, Converting It Into an Independent National High School to be Known as Kiara National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Kiara của Trường Trung học Bocboc Quốc gia tại Barangay Kiara, Đô thị Don Carlos, Tỉnh Bukidnon khỏi Trường Trung học Bocboc Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Kiara Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Kiara ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bocboc แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Kiara เทศบาล Don Carlos จังหวัด Bukidnon ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bocboc แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Kiara แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Kiara, Sekolah Menengah Bocboc Nasional di Barangay Kiara, Kotamadya Don Carlos, Provinsi Bukidnon dari Sekolah Menengah Bocboc Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kiara Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Kiara, Sekolah Menengah Bocboc Kebangsaan di Barangay Kiara, Perbandaran Don Carlos, Wilayah Bukidnon daripada Sekolah Menengah Bocboc Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Kiara Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: - The Bocboc National High School - Kiara Annex in Barangay Kiara, Municipality of Don Carlos, Province of Bukidnon is hereby separated from the Bocboc National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Kiara National High School.
- All personnel, assets, liabilities, and records of the Bocboc National High School - Kiara Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Kiara National High School.

- The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Kiara National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year's appropriation of the Bocboc National High School - Kiara Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the annual General Appropriations Act.
- The Secretary of Education shall formulate the rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act within one hundred twenty (120) days after its effectivity.
- This act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in any newspaper of general circulation.
